notes.title: Pokémon adventure — Battle motion
notes.text: An adventure-focused singles engine with individual IV/EV/Nature/gender and stable seeded abilities. Supported ability, held-item and weather effects are resolved locally. One shared item stock, validated localized story receipts, Pokémon Centers, level/TM/Tutor training, trainer teams, eight Kanto Gyms, rare quests, trade-back and common conditional evolution, player-only Sandbox, and branch-aware progress. Starter and kit creation choices are authoritative. Reference-only abilities/items and unsupported moves must never be assigned invented effects. Battle transformations, PvP and breeding are outside this release. Battle animations show saved encounter, capture success/failure and battle outcomes, with skip and a per-character setting; reduced motion skips animation.
